log: note '4-bit DAC: @OUT (the stone 4 1 0) is powered with N = 8 B3 + 4 B2 + 2 B1 + B0, 12 ticks after any input'
label B3 -1 1 -2 'bit 3 (8): repeater at the west edge, driven from the west'
label B2 -1 1 2 'bit 2 (4): wire at the west edge, driven from the west'
label B1 -1 1 -4 'bit 1 (2): wire at the west edge, driven from the west'
label B0 -1 1 4 'bit 0 (1): wire at the west edge, driven from the west'
label OUT 4 1 0 'output: a stone powered with N'
label K0 3 1 0 'last chain comparator (its output is N)'
group dac4 -1 1 -5 4 1 5 in @B0 B0 in @B1 B1 in @B2 B2 in @B3 B3 out @OUT OUT
label READ 5 1 0 'reader: a comparator after OUT'
target new values 'counting 0..15, one step every 16 ticks from 26 (7 -> 8 flips all four bits): OUT reaches every value 12 ticks after its step, never anything else'
target new t0_15 '0 -> 15 at 30: 0 until 41, 15 from 42'
target new t1_14 '1 -> 14 at 30: 1 until 41, 14 from 42'
target new t2_13 '2 -> 13 at 30: 2 until 41, 13 from 42'
target new t3_12 '3 -> 12 at 30: 3 until 41, 12 from 42'
target new t4_11 '4 -> 11 at 30: 4 until 41, 11 from 42'
target new t5_10 '5 -> 10 at 30: 5 until 41, 10 from 42'
target new t6_9 '6 -> 9 at 30: 6 until 41, 9 from 42'
target new t7_8 '7 -> 8 at 30: 7 until 41, 8 from 42'
target new t8_7 '8 -> 7 at 30: 8 until 41, 7 from 42'
target new t9_6 '9 -> 6 at 30: 9 until 41, 6 from 42'
target new t10_5 '10 -> 5 at 30: 10 until 41, 5 from 42'
target new t11_4 '11 -> 4 at 30: 11 until 41, 4 from 42'
target new t12_3 '12 -> 3 at 30: 12 until 41, 3 from 42'
target new t13_2 '13 -> 2 at 30: 13 until 41, 2 from 42'
target new t14_1 '14 -> 1 at 30: 14 until 41, 1 from 42'
target new t15_0 '15 -> 0 at 30: 15 until 41, 0 from 42'
target new unbalanced 'failure case: all four input repeaters at delay 1 (bit 0 then takes 6 ticks, bit 3 12): 0 -> 9 at 30 shows 1 for 6 ticks first'
target unbalanced do set -1 1 -2 repeater facing=west delay=1
target unbalanced do set 0 1 2 repeater facing=west delay=1
target unbalanced do set 1 1 -4 repeater facing=west delay=1
target unbalanced do set 2 1 4 repeater facing=west delay=1

B3.note: bit 3 (8): repeater at the west edge, driven from the west

B2.note: bit 2 (4): wire at the west edge, driven from the west

B1.note: bit 1 (2): wire at the west edge, driven from the west

B0.note: bit 0 (1): wire at the west edge, driven from the west

OUT.note: output: a stone powered with N

K0.note: last chain comparator (its output is N)
